description: Radxa ROCK 5C, 2 GB variant (Rockchip RK3588S2), on order. A board record: Atlas flashes it from maskrom (rockusb) with Rockchip's loader file and no vendor tool; running, it serves the identity contract (board-lite, gaia/device.toml), read-only. Written from Radxa's docs, the Linux device tree and rkdeveloptool; untested on this board.

network.ethernet: Gigabit; PHY of the RTL8211F family (rk3588s-rock-5c.dts); PoE through the optional HAT
network.wifi_bt: Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, external antenna connector (docs.radxa.com ROCK 5C introduction)

ports: Upper USB 3.0 Type-A port: the OTG port (used for maskrom and flashing)
One eMMC module connector, shared with the SPI flash connector (eMMC and SPI are mutually exclusive)

storage_target_evidence: docs.radxa.com ROCK 5C introduction and hardware interface: one 'eMMC Socket && SPI Flash Connector' (no module fitted by default), mutually exclusive, and a microSD slot.
The image is a whole disk as Gaia writes it for eMMC (idblock at sector 64, U-Boot, partitions), written from byte 0.
instructions: Power the ROCK 5C off and take out any microSD card; fit the eMMC module (the SPI flash connector takes no module at the same time).
Short the Maskrom pin hole with a DuPont wire (the ROCK 5C has no Maskrom button).
Connect the top USB 3.0 port (the OTG port) to this computer with a USB-A to USB-A cable, then power the board on and remove the wire.
The board appears as 2207:350b (RK3588 maskrom). Atlas runs the loader's DDR init and usbplug, writes the image to the eMMC, reads it back and restarts the board.
todo: 2207:350b as RK3588 maskrom comes from secondary sources (MNT, Radxa's guides via search): rkdeveloptool 304f073's 99-rk-rockusb.rules stops at 350a and doesn't name it. UNCONFIRMED until lsusb on the board shows 2207:350b.

UNCONFIRMED: the order of the pin short and power-on. Radxa's Android install snippet says short before power-on; the record follows the maskrom page (power on, then remove the wire). Check on the board with the trace.

The rkbin parts are in fetch.lock (not in git): rkbin f43a462's RK3588MINIALL.ini names rk3588_ddr_lp4_2112MHz_lp5_2400MHz_v1.18, rk3588_usbplug_v1.11 and rk3588_spl_v1.13, and builds rk3588_spl_loader_v1.18.113.bin with boot_merger. rkbin doesn't publish the merged file; Gaia's build (which runs boot_merger) is its source. Gaia needs: the merged loader (rk3588_spl_loader_v*.bin) and the eMMC image (sdcard.img, whole disk).

Whether the RK3588S2 takes the RK3588 loader unchanged. Gaia's ROCK 5C build ships rk3588_spl_loader_v1.18.113.bin (rkbin at its Buildroot 2026.02.3 pin, f43a462) next to sdcard.img; Atlas's parser reads it (chip 3588, 2 DDR entries incl. UsbHead, usbplug, FlashHead/Data/Boot, RC4 off) and its idblock agrees with its RKNS FlashHead, so only the board's run is left.
UNCONFIRMED: the LED states during maskrom and flashing. The device tree gives only the power LED's default (on).
